card.name: Citations of laws before section numbers
card.fires_on: The spot right before a statute or directive number, such as the space after "Public Law" or "Section" or the period in "P.L.". It appears in legal and government text naming acts and codes.

modes.label: Before law number
modes.description: The space or period right after a law abbreviation, just before the number.
modes.example: value of the Landsat program was recognized by Congress in October 1992 when it passed the Land Remote Sensing Policy Act (Public Law<< >>102-555)

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: The word Section or section, or a link word just before it, when pointing to a part of an act or code.
modes.example: report annually on their releases of toxic chemicals to the environment (under the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act of 1986,<< Section>> 313)

modes.label: Punctuation after act names
modes.description: A bracket or quote mark after an act's name or year, leading into a short name or quoted phrase.
modes.example: , see Compensation Discrimination published by the EEOC. Notification and Federal Employee Antidiscrimination and Retaliation Act of 2002<< (>>No Fear Act) The No Fear Act
